name: Iron cage
description: A riveted iron cage a person could crouch in, 1.1 m square and 1.45 m high to its roof: flat iron bands round four corner posts, round bars on every side, a barred roof with a hanging ring, a floor of iron slats on short feet and a barred front door standing ajar on strap hinges, an open padlock hanging from its staple.

provenance.prompt: A riveted iron cage a person could crouch in, door ajar, about 1.2 × 1.2 × 1.6 m.
